text.tspan: Day 2: "the server is slow": check in this order, then signals and systemd
High load + low CPU + high wa = waiting on disk (D state). df full but du small = deleted file still open.
"No space left" but df shows space = inodes full (df -i). Process vanished, no app log = OOM killer (dmesg).
15 SIGTERM (default kill): ask to stop, app cleans up
9 SIGKILL: kernel kills at once, can't be caught
A zombie (Z) can't be killed: fix or restart its parent.
systemd: run and watch a service
